Name: BONFIRE_WARP_SUB_CATEGORY_PARAM_ST
Description: Subcategories (headings) of the Site of Grace warp list. A grace points here with its Subcategory ID; its subcategory's Tab ID decides the tab it's listed in. In a tab, each subcategory's heading comes first, followed by its graces in their Sort Order in Subcategory.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail sets it on most rows, which work normally).

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Heading text of the subcategory, from Menu Text. Below 0: no heading is shown, but its graces are still listed.

Fields.Name: Tab ID
Fields.Description: The BonfireWarpTabParam row this subcategory and its graces are listed in.

Fields.Name: Sort Order in Tab
Fields.Description: Order of this subcategory within its tab, ascending.
